messages:
Priya: Heads-up — after today's seed run we have ~3k trial owners getting multiple playbook touches. Owners are confused at SLA handoff and some are getting duplicate sequences. Need quick heuristics to reduce noise.
Alex: Ugh. Seen similar before. Can we suppress seed touches for any owner who had a manual outreach in last 7d? Also add a seed_source tag so ops can filter. :thinking_face:
Jordan: Data note — duplication is coming from two sources: legacy-import + webhook replays. I recommend dedupe key = email + account_id + source_hash. Quick SQL to check collisions:```SELECT account_id, email, count(*) FROM touches WHERE seed=true GROUP BY account_id, email HAVING count(*)>1;```
Maya: If we start suppressing, healthscore computations might drop these accounts temporarily. Suggest freezing the "seed" weight in healthscore for 72h after a seed touch so metrics don't oscillate.
Priya: Agreed. Proposal: 1) owner-suppress if last_manual_touch_ts > now() - interval '7 days' 2) dedupe at ingestion with the key Jordan suggested 3) healthscore freeze for seed tag 72h 4) expose a dry-run toggle for the playbook.
Alex: Can we get a playbook snippet? I can review and push to staging. :thumbsup:
Priya: Snippet (ops-friendly):```{
  "playbook": "seed-touch",
  "rules": [
    {"name":"dedupe_ingest","type":"ingest","key":"email|account_id|source_hash"},
    {"name":"owner_suppress","type":"suppression","condition":"last_manual_touch < interval '7 days'","action":"skip_touch"},
    {"name":"health_freeze","type":"metric_override","metric":"health_score","duration":"72h","scope":"tag:seed"}
  ],
  "dry_run": true
}```
Jordan: I'll add a quick post-process job to flag any still-duplicated rows and send a csv to #cs-ops for manual triage.
CS Bot: Dry-run deployed to staging for playbook=seed-touch. Estimated matches: 124 accounts. No live sends. :robot_face: 1769999990 deploy_id=stg-2023-09-seedcheck
Maya: Nice. After we validate, can we set up a dashboard card showing delta in outreach volume + healthscore delta over 7d? Helps PS and Enablement.
Alex: I'll own the staging review tomorrow AM. Priya — want to pair on rollout checklist?
Priya: Yes please. I'll put a brief checklist in the ops doc and tag you. Thanks all. :sparkles:
